notes.title: Update 2.0.0.0
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

It has been some time but we have created a new update that contains the following new features: 

New in 2.0 version:

We have made lots of improvement for your game experience! Enjoy the new functions and improvements!

NEW building functions:
- completely redesigned road and fence building: click to build and right click to remove, or demolish like before,
- roads and fence elements can be connected any sides and ways easily, 
- easier building, more time for the fun,
- roads and fence elements are completely free. Build as many as you wish!

NEW ICONS:
- now you can see if powerplants are out or water towers turned off by icons,

START EGG MINING CHAPER:
- egg mining got so much more cheaper than ever before,

POOP:
- dinos poop less and less often,

COLLECT MONEY FASTER:
- collect income by your tour cars more fast,

COLLECT LIKES more easily:
- get visitor's likes more fast,
- get more likes when they see dinosaurs,

BUG FIXES:
- we have fixed some bugs and improved the whole game and usability in many cases

As this is a huge update there may be some issues that may affect your game so please leave comments and feedback! Thanks!

*** Planned features for next major update 2.5.0.0:
- we plan to redesign the whole tutorial system with better icons and texts
- more language support is coming

notes.title: First Early Access Update 1.1.0.0
notes.content:
Dear Community, 

Thanks for your support and all your suggestions. I have created the first update that fix some bugs and make some small changes in settings: 

NEW: 
- autosave and classical save/load option added
- full screen option added,
- 16:9 aspect added,
- quit options added in settings menu,
- many more settings options added, 

BUG FIXES:
- EGGs signs added that were not showing making it impossible to find places to build mines. Sorry. :) 
- certain decoration options were not enabled to build now fixed,
- some parts and territories were not allowed on map now fixed,
- memory enhancements,

I believe that some of you will continue to support my work so I can upload new updates. Please share your thought on how I should improve the building tools. I am testing now to change fence and road build utilities to drag and drop style however it does not seems to be very easy :-) 

Thanks guys! I will upload some more videos and screenshots soon!
